answer: Instead of trusting a crowd of fresh names, the network can require each identity to publish a work-bound cipher and then gain weight only as unrelated reviewers slowly confirm it. Honest records accumulate like a glacier: each season of accepted work stays visible and hard to fabricate in bulk. Coordinated clones usually share one funding path and the same compressed diction, stacked as evenly as beds of shale, so settlement can withhold rewards until those histories actually diverge.
